tiers.CODE_SINGLE: exactly one source file names it (producer or lone reader)
tiers.DATED_CODE: dated snapshot, some source names it
tiers.DATED_ORPHAN: dated snapshot, nothing names it (its basename changes every session, so listed apart)
tiers.SCRATCH: not a face: chain receipts / quarantine / backups / hash-named scratch (leading '_' or a hex stem)

read: a face nothing names cannot have been read by a page; a face one file names may still be that file's own output, so CODE_SINGLE prints the file instead of claiming a consumer. ORPHAN means no literal namesake -- a path assembled at runtime (join(d, key + '.json')) also reads as ORPHAN, so the row carries stem_mentioned_in_code as the weaker signal.
